title: ARC: Adaptive Rollout Control for Efficient Synchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.29156v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models proceeds through a repeated rollout--barrier--update loop. Each update must wait for a fixed number of complete, group-relative training samples, yet individual response lengths and reward outcomes vary widely and only emerge as generation progresses. Static admission and unconditional completion therefore leave accelerators idle in some steps, and waste computation generating samples that will never contribute to the current update. We present ARC, a closed-loop rollout architecture that governs synchronous RL rollout at group granularity. ARC uses \textit{Calibrated Streaming Backfill} to judge from partial observations whether a group is still worth completing, backfilling a fresh candidate immediately when it is not; \textit{Deferred Group Completion} to park an uncertain early stop and resume it later instead of discarding it outright, bounded by a resume-cycle limit

translated_title: ARC：面向高效同步大语言模型强化学习的自适应Rollout控制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的同步强化学习（RL）通过重复的“采样—同步屏障—更新”循环进行。每次更新必须等待固定数量的完整的、组相对的训练样本，然而各个响应的长度和奖励结果差异很大，且只有在生成过程中才逐渐显现。因此，静态准入和无条件完成会导致加速器在某些步骤中闲置，并浪费计算资源去生成那些永远不会对当前更新做出贡献的样本。我们提出了ARC，一种以组为粒度管理同步RL采样的闭环采样架构。ARC利用“校准流式回填”根据部分观测判断一个组是否仍值得继续完成，当不值得时立即回填一个新的候选组；并利用“延迟组完成”将不确定的提前停止先搁置、稍后恢复，而非直接丢弃，同时受恢复周期上限的约束。
tldr: ARC提出了一种以组为粒度的闭环采样控制架构，通过校准流式回填与延迟组完成两项机制，动态判断样本组是否值得继续生成、及时回填新候选并延迟恢复不确定的提前停止，从而减少同步LLM强化学习中的加速器空闲与无效计算。
en_tdlr: ARC is a closed-loop rollout architecture that governs synchronous LLM RL rollouts at group granularity, using Calibrated Streaming Backfill and Deferred Group Completion to dynamically judge whether a group is worth completing, backfill fresh candidates, and defer uncertain early stops—thereby reducing accelerator idling and wasted computation.
